scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm:db:up" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.start: npm run db:deploy -w server && npm run start -w server
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w server && npm run test:coverage -w client
